theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (g : Euclid n → Euclid P) (B : Set (Euclid n)) (z : Euclid n) (s : ℝ) (f : Euclid P → ℝ), MeasurableSet B → (∀ a ∈ B, DifferentiableAt ℝ g a) → InjOn g B → (∀ a ∈ B, Injective (fderiv ℝ g a)) → 0 < s → ∫ y in Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap (g z) s '' (g '' B), f y ∂μHE[n] = ∫ b in {b : Euclid n | z + s • b ∈ B}, Real.sqrt (((fderiv ℝ g (z + s • b)).adjoint ∘L fderiv ℝ g (z + s • b)).det) * f (s⁻¹ • (g (z + s • b) - g z))
